title: Create your life movie, Pixar style
cardDesc: Use AI video models to create a montage of your life story, Pixar-style.

sections.title: Motivation
sections.content: When I was creating my personal website, I thought about the fastest and most fun way to introduce myself. The fastest way would be a few bullet points on my career highlights. But most fun? Definitely not. Everyone loves Pixar movies, and I do too. So I wondered: What if I could use video models to create a montage of my life?

sections.title: Implementation
sections.content: I was playing with the latest release of the Sora app and was blown away by the remix capabilities. It became obvious that the technology was ready. I just needed to write my life movie's script and direct my own film. With ChatGPT's help, I created 10 scenes that portray the arc of my 28 years and fed them into Sora. Since Sora is limited to 15-second videos, I stitched them together with CapCut.

paragraphs: The detail page includes example prompts for each scene—video prompts and narration prompts you can use as a starting point for your own life movie.
